subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: Should OpenClaw preserve the shipped custom `nativeBaseUrl` video protocol during the DeepInfra endpoint transition, or intentionally require those users to reconfigure to an OpenAI-compatible videos endpoint?
rationale: A custom native endpoint cannot be safely converted by changing its URL because the old and new endpoints use different request and polling protocols, so accepting the retirement requires explicit ownership of an upgrade break.

options.title: Preserve explicit native endpoints
options.body: Use the new endpoint by default, migrate only known `api.deepinfra.com` values, and retain legacy native execution when an existing custom `nativeBaseUrl` is explicitly configured.

options.title: Approve breaking retirement
options.body: Remove native custom-endpoint support with explicit release communication, upgrade documentation, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof showing the intended failure and recovery path.

options.title: Split the changes
options.body: Land the DeepSeek compatibility tagging separately and defer the video endpoint transition until its upgrade contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit native endpoints
recommendation.body: Use the new endpoint by default, migrate only known `api.deepinfra.com` values, and retain legacy native execution when an existing custom `nativeBaseUrl` is explicitly configured.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice intentionally governs a shipped provider configuration and upgrade contract, and the PR timeline explicitly routes the compatibility question to this reviewer.
